aura_equinox.use: EQUINOX v5 (Sol's RNG Transcendent): the avatar stands at the centre of a huge black-and-white galaxy disc (spiral clouds, rings, stardust) with the balance glyph behind them; a cloudy light planet and a dark planet with a cracked glowing rim and a star blazing inside orbit the avatar as HD 3D planets (cloudy ForceField atmosphere; a rocky black crust inside a cracked rim with a blazing star), with small moons, a white and a black comet with trails, concentric HD ground rings turning, a spiral of light and a star field; ornate title. Nothing in front of the body. v5: a black-and-white sparkly aura hugs the avatar (white outline, sparkles off every limb, light and dark wisps), sparkle helixes, shockwaves, twinkling stars, a ringed light planet and an asteroid belt circling everything. v5: the planets are UV-mapped globes wearing real surface maps (swirling clouds; black rock split by glowing cracks) inside rune rings, as on the wiki.

ratings.note: looked nothing like the wiki; covered the avatar
needs more particle effects, more moving parts, higher-res 3D models
7-8; wants more detail, movement and a sparkly aura for 9-10

aura_equinox.note: v5 good enough; still short of the wiki's next-level quality

aura_luminosity.use: LUMINOSITY v5 (Sol's RNG Transcendent): a huge crystal-blade star behind the avatar (tall top blade, long hooked wings, diagonals) over a blinding core, slow rays and a deep glow, a crystal spear across its base, ripples on the ground, HD 3D glass crystal blades with white-hot neon cores forming the star, ice shards with trails and two comets circling the avatar, ground ripple rings, a halo ring, ice glints, snow, core ray bursts and updraft; ornate serif title. Nothing in front of the body. v5: an icy sparkly aura hugs the avatar (outline glow, sparkles and wisps off every limb), sparkle helixes, shockwaves, twinkling stars and a wheel of stars turning behind the blades. v5: the star is dark steel-blue blades with glowing white edges and engraved grooves (as on the wiki).

aura_breakthrough.use: BREAKTHROUGH v5 (Sol's RNG Transcendent): a giant hand of five crystal pillars built from glowing cubes rises behind the avatar, tips blazing, over an arc ring, rays and a deep violet glow; a light burst on the ground and HD glass crystal fingers with neon cores and frozen blocks, a tumbling cube halo and light wisps with trails circling the avatar, ground rings, floor shards, updraft streaks, mist and debris; ornate title. Nothing in front of the body. v5: a violet sparkly aura hugs the avatar (outline glow, sparkles and wisps off every limb), sparkle helixes, shockwaves, twinkling stars, sparks circling every crystal tip. v5: the fingers are translucent glass slabs with glowing edge frames and lit caps, packed with dark and lit cubes that break out of their sides and dissolve (as on the wiki).
